cause_quote: The new src/shared/agent-onboarding.ts hardcoded the saved greeting in English: `return name ? `Hi, I’m ${name}. Happy to help.` : "Hi! Happy to help.";`, and agents.create carried no locale.
user_saw: A user with a non-English Control UI language who created a new agent got an English introduction and an English role question.
summary: Adds an optional locale to agents.create, saves the onboarding introduction from a per-locale table, and tells the model to ask the opening role question in the user's selected language.
reasoning: The greeting builder and onboarding opening prompt were introduced in #175291 (413d2fc) with English-only text and no locale input; git log shows agent-onboarding.ts was untouched between that commit and the fix, so the English-only greeting shipped with the feature rather than being broken later. Confidence is medium because localizing the greeting could also be read as a feature extension rather than a defect, though the Control UI is localized into 23 languages and the fix is titled and framed as a fix.
